name: Rajan Gupta
tagline: I find where AI products break, slow down, or overspend before users do.
subtitle: AI Product Manager, moving from 15+ years in performance engineering across banking, enterprise SaaS, and the public sector.
supportingBody: I start with the user's problem, then decide what is worth building.
currentRole: Performance Test Lead · Bank of Montreal
aboutParagraphs: I'm a performance engineering lead moving into AI product management, where I start with the problem and work toward the smallest fix that solves it. At Bank of Montreal, I lead the performance work on moving on-premise services to AWS Lambda, which improved deployment speed by 40%, and I influence the product roadmap from that seat. I have worked on the problems that slow products down. At Bank of America, I helped make CashPro Mobile faster and user retention rose 7%. At MTX Group, I worked on customer-facing gaps across U.S. agencies and contributed to 663% revenue growth, from $157K to $1.2M in 14 months.

For 15+ years in Performance Engineering and Quality Assurance, I have found bottlenecks and audited edge cases, so I ask one question first: what is going wrong for the user, and what does it cost? AI products fail in familiar ways: they are slow, wrong, or too expensive to run. Managing the trade-offs between latency, accuracy, and cost is the daily work of LLM-powered products in 2026.
My working stack: Claude AI for research synthesis, Google AI Studio for rapid prototyping, and n8n for workflow automation.
